extraction_notes: The datasheet is a family sheet for DSK32 THRU DSK320. DSK34 uses the DSK32-DSK34 grouped value for maximum forward voltage (0.55 V at IF = 3.0 A), the DSK32-DSK36 grouped values for maximum DC reverse current (0.2 mA at TA = 25 degC, 20 mA at TA = 100 degC), and the DSK32-DSK34 grouped typical junction capacitance (250 pF).

Fig. 3 forward-voltage curve was digitized for the solid DSK32-DSK34 curve at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle. Fig. 4 reverse-characteristic curves were digitized for the solid DSK32-DSK34 curves at Tj = 25 degC, 75 degC, and 100 degC. Points are readings from the supplied plots, not interpolated table values.

Fig. 4 y-axis decade positions were calibrated from the printed 10000/1000/100/10/1 uA axis labels, which are uniformly spaced; digitized reverse currents are consistent with the table maxima (6.9 uA at 100% rated VR and 25 degC versus 200 uA maximum; 6.0 mA at 100 degC versus 20 mA maximum).

The maximum reverse-current table value for DSK34 is 0.2 mA at VR = VDC = 40 V and TA = 25 degC. The same table gives 20 mA at TA = 100 degC; the required reverse_current field records the 25 degC row.
Typical junction capacitance is 250 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz, represented as 2.5e-10 F.

Absolute maximum ratings for DSK34 include VRRM = 40 V, VRMS = 28 V, VDC = 40 V, IF(AV) = 3.0 A, IFSM = 80 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, Tj = -55 to +125 degC, Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, RthJA = 80 degC/W, and RthJL = 20 degC/W. These ratings are not breakdown characterization data. Package SOD-123FL, device marking code K34.
The supplied PDF identifies Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd.; the top-level manufacturer preserves the exact job identity hongjiacheng.

The PDF also contains a forward-current derating plot (Fig. 1) and a non-repetitive surge-current rating plot (Fig. 2, 80 A at 1 cycle decaying to about 19 A at 100 cycles); they are not diode IV or reverse-characteristic curves and are retained only as rating evidence in this extraction note.
omission_reason: The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time or reverse-breakdown characteristic; reverse_recovery, breakdown_voltage, and breakdown_current remain null.
